item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
Issued at 02:05 PM 10 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Romblon(Cajidiocan, SanFernando, Magdiwang), #OrientalMindoro(Naujan, CityOfCalapan, Baco), #Albay(Libon), #CamarinesSur(Bato, Libmanan, Caramoan), #CamarinesNorte(SanLorenzoRuiz, Basud, JosePanganiban, Mercedes), #NorthernSamar(Bobon, Victoria, SanVicente), #Masbate(Palanas, Cataingan), #Marinduque(Torrijos and Buenavista) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #NorthernSamar(SilvinoLobos, Mondragon, Pambujan, LasNavas, SanRoque, LopeDeVega, Catarman, SanIsidro, Capul, SanAntonio), #Masbate(Claveria, SanPascual, Mandaon), #Marinduque(Mogpog, Boac, Gasan, SantaCruz), #CamarinesNorte(SantaElena, Capalonga, Paracale, Labo, Vinzons, Talisay, SanVicente, Daet), #Albay(Oas, Tiwi, Malinao, Polangui), #CamarinesSur(Buhi, IrigaCity), #Sorsogon(Castilla, Pilar, CityOfSorsogon, PrietoDiaz), #Catanduanes(Caramoran) and #OrientalMindoro(Bulalacao) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
